nom: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine, better oil control through the day, and fewer breakouts, with several calling it their holy grail for oily t-zones.
segments.dry: Some reviewers report new dryness, flaking, or under-nose dryness after starting the product, though others with dry/combo skin say it helped balance dehydrated patches.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report clearer skin and reduced oil on the nose and forehead, though a few note increased dryness in certain areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report no irritation at all and successful use on acne-prone sensitive skin, while others describe burning, redness, swelling, or breakouts strong enough to warrant discontinuing.
segments.mature: One reviewer with adult-onset, perimenopausal acne reports no improvement in acne or hyperpigmentation and disliked the sticky residue under makeup.

concerns.aging: A rosacea-affected reviewer's husband saw scarring and discoloration even out over time; no other aging-specific effects (fine lines, firmness) are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe dryness, tightness, or flaking after use, particularly under the nose or on cheeks, while others with dehydrated combination skin say the serum controlled oil without worsening dryness.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report reduced redness and improved rosacea-related complexion; a smaller number instead describe new redness, burning, or irritation appearing after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes swelling and eye irritation with prolonged use that stopped when discontinued; another credits the product with helping restore her moisture barrier over time.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fewer clogged pores, reduced blackheads, and visibly smaller pores; one reviewer says it did not reduce her blackheads despite repeat purchases.
concerns.blemishes: The majority of acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active pimples, and lightened acne scarring over weeks of use; however, a notable minority report new or worsened breakouts, including cystic pimples and small patches in new areas.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers overwhelmingly report noticeably less shine and better oil control within days to weeks of consistent use, with very few dissenting on this point.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky texture on skin

extraits.titre: I had hope.. now I'm trashing it
extraits.texte: I tried adding this product to my skincare routine, I will be throwing it away. This product is the only one I have had issues with. I do not have sensitive skin at all yet this is causing dryness, redness, irritation, burning and even some swelling. Also does not seem to react well with other skin care products as ive never dealt with piling until this serum. I have read in depth all the things not to do to avoid every issue I have just incase it is user error on my part but by process of elimination I feel I can confidently say it is not user error and is in fact just the product. I did a lot of reading and seems many have these same issues with the ordinary brand niacinimide that I am having. I have about 8 other ordinary products I swear by so this was devastating for this one to be so horrible.

extraits.titre: Where Has This Been All My Life?!
extraits.texte: I have a very oily t-zone with sensitive combo skin. It's only flaw is it might be irritating for sensitive skin, but only minorly and is temporary. Mostly when you apply it fresh after washing your face. In 3 days I've already noticed a HUGE reduction in oil around my nose and between my eyebrows. My skin is loving this!

extraits.titre: Great for my sensitive, acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I am in my 30's and have annoyingly sensitive and acne prone skin that is also somehow oily and dry at the same time. Basically, all of the problems. My skin has loved this product. I layer it on bare skin under my moisturizer in the morning and it helps control excess oil all day. My acne has also lessened over time, although it is not totally gone. My pores seem a bit more refined and redness reduced. I actually have been skipping makeup for the past few days because my skin is looking so nice (and I am at usually a bad skin time of the month, iykyk). Best of all, no bad reaction at all to this product for my ultra sensitive skin. Only negative is that it does sometimes pill if I apply it when my skin is oily already at all, so it has to be applied to freshly washed skin only. I've repurchased this many times.

This serum has been a staple in my skincare routine for 6+ years now, and it's my favorite TO product to date because it is literally the ONLY thing that has ever had any effect on my incredibly oily skin. I love trying new products, but the niacinamide + zinc is the one thing I absolutely do not want to be without. It took weeks of consistent use (3 drops in the AM and PM), and I did experience some mild purging in the first couple of months, but I went from needing to blot my face every 1-2 hours to occasionally needing to blot once or twice a day! I've also noticed fewer breakouts (I used to get painful cystic acne along my jawline, which rarely happens anymore). To anyone who is considering adding this to their skincare routine: definitely do a patch test first. Also, crosscheck the ingredients list with any other products that you use to make sure that everything will play well together. Some products can cause irritation if used together, while others can actually make each other less effective. (There are apps that can help with this.)

extraits.titre: Beware if you are sensitive! But it's amazing!
extraits.texte: This serum really helps with my skin! My pores have been rapidly vanishing out of sight and my skin doesn't really even get oily anymore due to this product. Quick warning, it is a strong product and for those with more sensitive skin it might be a little too strong and cause breakouts. I hate recommended it to my sister, saying that it helped me with pores and acne, but when she wore it it caused break outs due to some acne treatments she was doing at the time. I've got combination skin, and it does cause some further dryness on those parts of my face, but it is really quite easy compared to doing a face mask every other day. The packaging is also quite nice, and I was glad I could take it on my trip. I haven't been able to break it even though I dropped it. Overall, it is a wonderful product, but just know your face.

I was dealing with fungal acne on my face that was so itchy and uncomfortable. My skin on my nose was so irritated and sensitive, I learned zinc is good for fungal acne issues so I started using this every other day/every few days and it has truly saved my skin. I have been using it for 6 weeks now and since I incorporated this into my skincare routine I have not dealt with that fungal acne since. It also has helped control how oily my T Zone often gets. I feel like over time I have begun to see a difference in the discoloration in my cheeks too, but that was never too bad to begin with for me. This product has not pilled under my moisturizer and sunscreen. I do not wear makeup so I cannot attest to it pilling then, but I find the formula and feeling is fine. My skin does not feel tingly or weird when I use it either. I am about 2/3 through the bottle after 6 weeks at 3 to 4 uses per week. Absolutely worth it.

Ok so I noticed theres VERY mixed reviews about this; keep in mind that not all acne is the same. I have developed acne at 37 yrs old due to pre menopause/aging. Someone who has acne at 14, or from PCOS, or even because they dont cleanse their face effectively is all different and different things work for different types. This product personally did nothing for me. It didnt help help my acne, didnt lighten any hyperpigmentation from past acne (which high strength niacinamide should do) and you have to use tons of product to cover your face because as soon as it hits the skin it pretty much absorbs completely. Additionally, it leaves such a sticky film on the face that makes my foundation look terrible. I will never use this again.
